notes: Introduced versioned self-update: added VERSION and CHANGELOG.json, and the -update command.
Fixed -update writing files with a UTF-8 BOM (Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 adds one on Windows PowerShell), which corrupted synced files with a stray character and noisy diffs.

Split project types into config/projectTypes.json (built-in, synced by -update) and config/projectTypes.local.json (your saved types, never touched by -update). Previously -update would have overwritten any custom project type you saved.

Fixed -update's release-notes step throwing on Windows PowerShell 5.1: wrapping ConvertFrom-Json's array output in @() could collapse a multi-entry CHANGELOG.json into a single flattened item. Now fetches the raw text and parses it directly.
The -new wizard's project folder step now shows a selection menu of the subfolders under devDirectory, with an 'Enter custom path...' option to fall back to free text.

MyShortcuts.ps1's -d now always opens the MyShortcuts folder in the terminal and lists it (the -terminal/-t switch was removed). Added a new -e/-explorer switch to open the folder in Windows Explorer instead. The -edit command's -e alias was removed to free up -e for this.
Updated README.md and CLAUDE.md to document the -d/-e change from 1.0.5 (README's usage table and CLAUDE.md's manager description previously still referenced the removed -t switch).

Split features into config/features.json (built-in, synced by -update) and config/features.local.json (your own custom features, never touched by -update), merged at runtime by Get-MergedFeatures. This mirrors the projectTypes.json/.local split and lets a downstream fork carry custom features that survive updates from upstream. If you have no features.local.json, behavior is unchanged.
Renamed the 'open solution' switch from -project/-p to -solution/-sln.

The solution feature now finds the solution automatically: at run time it opens an explicitly configured $sln if present, otherwise auto-detects a solution file in the project folder, preferring the modern .slnx over .sln. Compile (-release/-debug) uses the same detection. The -new wizard proposes an existing solution file it finds in the chosen folder (Enter = use existing <file>).
Added a data-driven 'detect' field for feature prompts (array of glob patterns) that powers the wizard's solution proposal; documented in CLAUDE.md.
Project types: dropped tunnel and azurite from the pre-checked .NET set, and merged the identical Node.js and Python types into a single 'Simple - editor-centric' type.
